The proposed solution is correct.

Starting from 3 + 1/x = 7/x, multiplying both sides by x (valid since x ≠ 0, which is required for the reciprocal to exist) gives 3x + 1 = 7, so 3x = 6 and x = 2. Substituting back gives 3 + 1/2 = 7/2 = 3.5 on both sides, which confirms the solution. Since the equation is linear after clearing denominators, x = 2 is the only solution.
